summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test plus non-node and graph-unchanged tests. New tests and test/test_path.py pass (43 passed). Not run: mypy, ruff, black, isort, because they are not installed in the shared venv and I was not allowed to install them; line length (88) was checked with awk. Nothing committed. Choice made: an explicit blank-node guard was added so None and strings are not used as lookup wildcards.
